scripts.setup: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec tsx scripts/setup.ts
scripts.dev: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec tsx scripts/dev.ts
scripts.dev:app: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec vite dev
scripts.runner: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec tsx features/runner/main.ts
scripts.build: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec vite build
scripts.start: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec vite preview
scripts.deploy: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec vinext-cloudflare deploy
scripts.deploy:dry: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec cf deploy --prebuilt --dry-run
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec cf workers types && node node_modules/typescript-native/bin/tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && prettier --check .
scripts.proof:mock: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec tsx scripts/proof.ts mock
scripts.proof:real: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec tsx scripts/proof.ts real
scripts.proof:browser: node scripts/tool.mjs pnpm exec playwright test
